2607.15257.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
2607.15257.paper_summary: Recent advances in Tool-Integrated Large Language Models have made web search a core capability of information-seeking agents. However, as interaction histories grow, agents increasingly struggle to track task progress. When search attempts fail to yield useful evidence, current single- and multi-agent systems can become trapped in repetitive loops, wasting search budgets and ultimately compromising the quality and completeness of the final output. We introduce SearchOS, a system-level multi-agent framework that turns fragile, implicit search progress into explicit, persistent, and shared state. First, we formulate open-domain information seeking as relational schema completion with grounded citations, where agents discover entities, populate attributes across linked tables, and anchor each value to source evidence. Then we design Search-Oriented Context Management (SOCM), which externalizes the evolving state into Frontier Task, an Evidence Graph, a Coverage Map, and Failure Memory. Built on SOCM, SearchOS applies a pipeline-parallel scheduling mechanism that overlaps the execution of sub-agents and continuously refills freed slots with tasks targeting unresolved coverage gaps to improve utilization and throughput. To schedule and control the execution of search agents, SearchOS introduces a Search Tool Middleware Harness that intercepts model and tool interactions to record grounded evidence and react to stalls or budget exhaustion, and provides a reusable hierarchical skill system comprising strategy and access skills to augment the agents' search process and avoid repeating failed search patterns across runs. On WideSearch and GISA, SearchOS leads all metrics among the evaluated single- and multi-agent baselines, paving the way toward robust information-seeking collaboration.
2607.15257.paper_summary_zh: 最近在工具整合的大型語言模型方面的進展，使得網頁搜索成為信息尋求代理的核心能力。<lb/>然而，隨著互動歷史的增長，代理在跟踪任務進展方面越來越困難。<lb/>當搜索嘗試未能產生有用的證據時，當前的單一和多代理系統可能會陷入重複循環，浪費搜索預算，最終影響最終輸出的質量和完整性。<lb/>我們介紹了SearchOS，一個系統級的多代理框架，將脆弱的、隱式的搜索進展轉變為明確的、持久的和共享的狀態。<lb/>首先，我們將開放域的信息尋求形式化為帶有基礎引用的關係模式補全，其中代理發現實體，填充鏈接表中的屬性，並將每個值固定到來源證據上。<lb/>然後，我們設計了搜索導向的上下文管理（SOCM），將不斷演變的狀態外部化為前沿任務、一個證據圖、一個覆蓋圖和失敗記憶。<lb/>基於SOCM，SearchOS應用了一個管道並行調度機制，重疊子代理的執行，並持續用針對未解決覆蓋空白的任務填補釋放的空槽，以提高利用率和吞吐量。<lb/>為了調度和控制搜索代理的執行，SearchOS引入了一個搜索工具中介系統，攔截模型和工具的互動，以記錄基礎證據並對停滯或預算耗盡做出反應，並提供一個可重用的分層技能系統，包含策略和訪問技能，以增強代理的搜索過程，並避免在多次運行中重複失敗的搜索模式。<lb/>在WideSearch和GISA上，SearchOS在所有評估的單一和多代理基準中領先於所有指標，為穩健的信息尋求協作鋪平了道路。
